title: Subset intersection expectation formula
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\rho\in\mathbb R$, let $S$ be a subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $g$ be any real-valued function on its subsets. The weighted average of $g(S\cap K)$ over all subsets $K\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, with weight $\rho^{|K|}(1-\rho)^{n-|K|}$, equals $\sum_{J\subseteq S}\rho^{|J|}(1-\rho)^{|S\setminus J|}g(J)$.
hypotheses_covered: Arbitrary real-valued function $g$ on subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
